on Thursday that it had initiated a private offering of $600M in senior notes maturing in 2034.
The company intends to use the net proceeds to finance the purchase price of its previously announced acquisition of EnviroServe.
Furthermore, the company plans to use remaining proceeds to repay borrowings under its revolving credit facility incurred to partially finance the acquisition of ES&H.
The offering will proceed regardless of whether the acquisitions are completed, and any unused proceeds will support general corporate purposes if either deal does not close.

title: Clean Harbors announces $600M senior notes offering
